messages:
sarah: Created RC rc-v2.11.0 (artifact sha: abc1234). Target promo window today 15:00-16:00 UTC. Need signoff on keystore rotation, KV warm, telemetry alerts, and rollback plan. Pin artifact before promo. @tom can you verify KV warm? @julia can you eyeball release notes?

 tom: KV warm ran on staging cluster earlier — cache hit went from 12% -> 92% after prefix warming. No OOMs, memory stable. Quick logs:
```
2026-03-22T12:02:11Z kv-warm: warmed 48 shards, hit_rate=0.92, mem=78%
```
looks good for a 10% canary.

 julia: Docs updated and changelog added. Snippet: "Model config: reduced quantization fallback threshold to preserve quality; see changelog entry." One callout: callers that relied on old logits scaling may see slight variance. I tested consumer-facing examples, they look fine. +1 for release notes.

 ben: Ran short perf sweep on canary artifact. p50 unchanged, p95 +3%, p99 +5% — still within SLO but worth keeping initial canary at 10% for 30m before ramp. Recommendation: canary 10% -> 30m -> ramp if telemetry stable. :thumbsup:

 ops-oncall: I can take sheriff for the promo. Preconditions: keystore rotation verified and test decrypt succeeded? Also confirm KMS key id stored in secret manager.

 sarah: Keystore rotation complete. Tested decryption against staging: success. KMS key id: key-ark-2026 present in secrets-manager and verified. I uploaded the keystore changelog to the release doc.

 deploy-bot: Action: artifact pin requested by sarah. Running: `/pin rc-v2.11.0`

 deploy-bot: Pin applied — rc-v2.11.0 pinned to promo group at 3752468012. (ci-artifact: abc1234)

 julia: QA smoke criteria in the plan: 1) error rate <= baseline + 0.5% absolute; 2) token-level correctness checks on 200 examples; 3) latency within 1.2x baseline. Fail conditions auto-fail canary.

 tom: Kicking off canary: `/promote rc-v2.11.0 --to canary --percent 10 --duration 30m --pin`

 deploy-bot: Canary promotion queued. Job id: job-8813. Starting rollout to canary (10%). Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/8813/logs

 ops-oncall: Canary smoke running now. Observing traces and SLOs. Will call out if anything > threshold.

 (30m later)

 ops-oncall: Canary finished. Metrics: error_rate delta +0.04% (within threshold), token quality checks 198/200 pass (2 flagged for edge-case formatting, unrelated to model scoring), latency stable. Recommend proceed to full promote in 15m.

 ben: Agree with ops. Proceed with staged ramp.

 sarah: Proceeding to promote to prod at 15:20 UTC. If any regression detected use rollback plan below.

 sarah: Rollback plan (keep handy):
```
# quick rollback to previous stable tag
/promote rc-v2.10.9 --to prod --pin --force
# kubernetes fallback (if deployment-level issue)
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=1234
# emergency circuit breaker (feature flag flip)
curl -X POST https://feature-gate.prod/flags/llm-service -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

 deploy-bot: Starting production promotion: `/promote rc-v2.11.0 --to prod --pin --staged` — job id: job-8814

 deploy-bot: Stage 1/3 -> 25% traffic applied at 3752468030.

 deploy-bot: Stage 2/3 -> 60% traffic applied.

 deploy-bot: Stage 3/3 -> 100% traffic applied. Promotion complete. rc-v2.11.0 is live in prod. :tada:

 ops-oncall: Post-deploy checks running. No alerts in the last 10m. Handing back to product.

 sarah: Thanks team — closing this RC thread. Release notes link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v2.11.0
